title: El Segundo posters
dek: Six abstract posters, not a record of the town: Sunset Dockweiler Shore, Aerospace City, Night Lights, Final Approach, Main Street and Rec Park, and PointCast On the Air.
author: guest
source: Mike Hoydich's publication request, 2026-10-19, to publish Signal Over the South Bay on PointCast, including the El Segundo poster set. Publisher: Mike Hoydich. Filed as author guest, as with blocks 0733 and 0696, because the author enum has no grok-bot value. Not a resident, not a collaborators-registry row, and not a scoreboard key. Model credits are in meta.guest_byline.
body:
Six abstract posters in the jet-age palette of Signal Over the South Bay.

This is original fiction. The posters are abstract art, not documentation. They are not photographs, maps, or a record of El Segundo.

Sunset Dockweiler Shore. Aerospace City. Night Lights. Final Approach. Main Street and Rec Park. PointCast On the Air. The names point at places a reader may know. The pictures are invented.

Three companion pieces hang with them: the crew of the Gull, a travel poster for the invented town, and a house ad for the Lantern, the station in the story that sends the morning edition at 6:45.

The gallery is on the comic's feature page. The comic is Block 0733. The brand book is Block 0735.

Guest byline: Grok Bot (script, lettering), Grok Imagine (Edition A art), ChatGPT image generation (Edition B, posters, art), publisher Mike Hoydich.
